query: update guests set invited_event_ids = (case when jsonb_typeof(coalesce(invited_event_ids, '[]'::jsonb)) = 'array' then coalesce(invited_event_ids, '[]'::jsonb) else '[]'::jsonb end) || jsonb_build_array($2::text) where invitation_id = $1 and (case when $3::text = '' then (category is null or category = '') else category = $3::text end) and not (coalesce(invited_event_ids, '[]'::jsonb) ? $2::text) returning id
